left_to_right.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  ;; Keep only large, nearly solid non-background components.
  (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
         (rects (filter (lambda (obj)
             (and (>= (obj-size obj) 9)
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
                      (rs (map fst cells)) (cs (map snd cells))
                      (oh (+ (- (max-list rs) (min-list rs)) 1))
                      (ow (+ (- (max-list cs) (min-list cs)) 1)))
                 (>= (/ (obj-size obj) (* oh ow)) 0.9))))
           objs))
         ;; Record each rectangle by center row, center column, and color.
         (centers (sort-by
           (map (lambda (obj)
             (let* ((rs (map fst (obj-cells obj)))
                    (cs (map snd (obj-cells obj))))
               (list (/ (+ (min-list rs) (max-list rs)) 2)
                     (/ (+ (min-list cs) (max-list cs)) 2)
                     (obj-color obj))))
             rects)
           first))
         (row-groups (list))
         (cur-row (list))
         (last-r #f))
    ;; Consecutive centers less than four rows apart belong to one output row.
    (for-each (lambda (entry)
      (if (or (not last-r) (< (- (first entry) last-r) 4))
          (set! cur-row (append cur-row (list entry)))
          (begin
            (set! row-groups (append row-groups (list (sort-by cur-row second))))
            (set! cur-row (list entry))))
      (set! last-r (first entry)))
      centers)
    (unless (empty? cur-row)
      (set! row-groups (append row-groups (list (sort-by cur-row second)))))
    ;; Emit the three rectangle colors in left-to-right order for every row.
    (let* ((nrows (length row-groups)) (ncols 3))
      (grid-from-fn nrows ncols (lambda (r c)
        (nth (nth (nth row-groups r) c) 2)))))))

limitations: Prototype only; the production generate(...) API remains canonical.
Evidence covers one seed and two bounded settings, not all seeds.
Episodes force the five-color column_repeat signature solely to guarantee identifiability.
Finite two-setting separation does not prove universal rule induction.
